fact: HISP UiO says that in early 2024 Mozambique had two climate-based malaria forecasting efforts, a Ministry of Health and CHAI early-warning dashboard pilot in DHIS2 and the national public health institute's models run manually, neither yet in routine use.

DHIS2 says Saudigitus installed the Chap Modelling Platform in Mozambique's production DHIS2 and, in testing with the malaria programme, its alerts flagged three possible outbreaks in two provinces four weeks ahead, but the system is not yet operational.
